source: The same day as page-a1-walk-four-moments told as one scene: one bench, one person, and the one deliberate jump la_dispute needs, in the walk's own caption «Le lendemain matin. Le même banc.». Hand-written. It must pass: a time jump with a caption is the writer's to use.

recent_situations.objective_native: Tell Camille you do not agree.
recent_situations.premise_fr: Chez Maître Vasseur. Camille attend. Elle veut que tu signes.
recent_situations.causal_reason: The flat's debt is a frightening word. → The learner knows the debt can take the flat and no more.

beats: On the bench by the canal, Lila and the learner have quarrelled about the photo and the insurer.
Lila walks off without a word.
The next morning, the same bench: Lila comes back with a pizza.
She sits down and opens the box between them.

change.before: The learner and Lila have never fought.
change.after: They have fought, and they are still here.

content.question: Will you share it with me?
content.task: Lila brings pizza and asks if you'll share it.

chapter.question: Are the learner and Lila still friends after the quarrel?
developments: Neither does, and they share a pizza anyway.

threads: Romance/friendship gate 3, the argument and the hesitant apology, belongs here.

content.premise_fr: Lila revient sur le quai avec une pizza.
content.chapter_question_fr: Lila et toi, encore amis après la dispute ?

panels.visual_direction: Evening, a bench by the canal. Lila stands, arms crossed; Toi sits with their back to us.
panels.narration_fr: Le soir. Un banc, le canal.

dialogue.text_fr: Oui, la photo au mur, c'est mon idée.
Un secret, c'est pire que l'assurance.

panels.visual_direction: Wide: Lila walks away along the quai, the bench empty beside Toi. No dialogue.
panels.narration_fr: Lila part. Elle ne dit rien.

panels.visual_direction: Morning light, the same bench. Lila comes along the quai with a pizza box.
panels.narration_fr: Le lendemain matin. Le même banc.

dialogue.text_fr: Une pizza. Le matin. Oui, je sais.

panels.visual_direction: Close on the box, open on the bench between Lila and Toi. One slice is missing.

content.setup_native: Lila comes back to the quai with a pizza.
content.hint_native: Lila wants to know if you will share the pizza.

lines_native: Yes, the photo on the wall was my idea.
A secret is worse than the insurance.
A pizza. In the morning. Yes, I know.
